visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand enters from the top right, holding a large, golden-brown fried chicken skewer heavily coated in bright orange chili powder. The camera is at a close-up macro distance, capturing the coarse texture of the crispy breading against a blurred urban street background with a white paper bag at the bottom. (2) A quick cut shows two hands holding a fan of five identical fried chicken skewers, emphasizing the quantity. The background features a wooden food stall with a yellow awning and soft natural daylight illuminating the scene. (3) The perspective shifts to an establishing shot of the street-side food stall named '老婆私廚' (Lao Po Si Chu). A man in a black shirt works behind the counter, surrounded by stainless steel equipment and a row of black scooters parked nearby on the asphalt. (4) A metal fryer basket is lifted from bubbling oil, revealing several golden-brown fried items. The lighting is bright and natural, casting soft shadows on the stainless steel tray where the items are placed to drain. (5) In a tight close-up, a hand uses a pink plastic shaker to dust a fried chicken skewer with white seasoning, followed by a purple shaker applying a dark powder. The focus is sharp on the falling particles and the uneven, craggy surface of the meat. (6) A sequence of macro shots displays various fried snacks: a piece of chicken is bitten to show the fibrous white meat and juice; a cheese croquette is pulled apart, revealing a thick, creamy white molten center; and a golden shrimp cake is dipped in red translucent sauce. (7) The final phase shows three pieces of tempura shrimp in a white box being drizzled with a light amber sauce from a small plastic packet, followed by a taro cake bitten to reveal a dense, purple mashed taro filling. The video ends with a repeat of the five-skewer fan and a yellow graphic overlay providing the stall's address and contact information.

The spectral centroid is bright, emphasizing clarity. (2) A distinct, sharp 'crunch' sound effect triggers a new phase as the narrator describes the texture of the chicken, followed by a low-frequency sizzling sound floor representing the deep fryer environment. (3) A soft, metallic 'clink' and a rhythmic 'shaking' sound effect accompany the description of seasoning being added to the skewers. The BGM remains constant in tempo. (4) A unique 'squelch' or 'pop' sound effect is heard as the narrator discusses the cheese croquette, emphasizing the melting texture. The vocal pitch rises slightly during this highlight. (5) A 'liquid pour' sound effect is clearly audible as sauce is drizzled over the shrimp tempura, adding a high-frequency transient to the mix. (6) A final series of crunch sound effects punctuates the description of the taro cake and other snacks, leading into a fast-paced, friendly sign-off from the narrator while the BGM fades out with a hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional food review intended to drive traffic to a specific street stall in Kaohsiung. It uses high-arousal narration, fast-paced editing, and hyper-focused macro visuals of fried food textures to stimulate appetite and emphasize the low price point of the chicken skewers.
